Vault.OnlyRenamingChangesTheName.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			[
				before.status === "",
				command._tag === "UpdateVault",
				after.display_name === before.display_name,
			].some((ok) => ok)

CreateCredential.OnlyAnActiveVaultTakesA.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			[
				before.vault.status === "active",
				before.credential.status === "",
				before.vault.credentials.length < MAX_VAULT_CREDENTIALS,
				after.vault.credentials.length === before.vault.credentials.length + 1,
				after.credential.status === "active",
				after.credential.vault_id === command.vault_id,
			].every((ok) => ok)

ArchiveCredential.AnArchivedCredentialLe.source:
({ after, command }) =>
			[
				after.credential.status === "archived",
				after.credential.vault_id === command.vault_id,
				after.vault.credentials.every((held) => held.credential_id !== command.credential_id),
			].every((ok) => ok)

DeleteCredential.ADeletedCredentialLeave.source:
({ after, command }) =>
			[
				after.credential.status === "deleted",
				after.vault.credentials.every((held) => held.credential_id !== command.credential_id),
			].every((ok) => ok)

Vaults.AHeldCredentialIsActiveInItsVault.source:
({ vault, credential }) =>
				[
					vault.state.credentials.every((held) => held.credential_id !== credential.id),
					[credential.state.status === "active", credential.state.vault_id === vault.id].every(
						(ok) => ok,
					),
				].some((ok) => ok)

McpServerSet.RecordedServersNeverChange.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[!before.recorded, [after.recorded, after.servers === before.servers].every((ok) => ok)].some(
				(ok) => ok,
			)
